notes: The site was located from the plan's own features: the conserved granary and workmen's quarters of Mound F lie at the north end of the protected, tree-covered area west of Harappa town, and the plan's Muslim tomb is the long tomb structure on Mound AB about 600 m to the south-east. Current imagery (Vantor Vivid 20250523, about 0.34 m) has no zoom-19 tiles here. Eight of the nine points lie on exposed Harappan masonry that has been conserved, so the 'without exposed masonry' subset has only the tomb and cannot be fitted. The points span about 320 m of a plan about 1100 m long; nothing south of the tomb could be identified. The fitted plan ink also places the plan's working-floor circles on the circular platforms seen in the imagery, which supports the fit. Seen without opening any file: the session's starting git status, and a later `git status` run to confirm which files I had written, list untracked conjecture files whose names state working hypotheses about town orientation (knowledge/conjectures/C-0015-towns-laid-out-on-star-settings.md and C-0016-plains-cities-on-true-north.md). They give no value for any plan, and I chose no point with them in mind.
